更新：1.1 版本将旧的动态提示通配符节点替换为动态提示通配符格式的完整（或至少更好）实现。它还添加了最后的升级和锐化步骤，将图像放大到 4k 并使用 Photon v1 进行锐化，赋予其锐利的细节和更饱和的色彩，而不会以其他方式扰乱图像。如果您不想进行第二个升级步骤，只需绕过 ComfyUI 中的这些节点即可。

这个工作流程非常适合创造奇妙的世界。它的工作原理是从您指定的文件夹中随机选择三张图像，然后将它们与 IP 适配器和提示一起组合起来，这样您最终得到的结果大致类似于艺术家使用灵感板。我个人收集了一个大文件夹的图像，我只是让它运行一段时间，看看它会产生什么结果。

需要注意的是，据我所知，没有一种方法可以自动计算文件夹中图像的数量，因此需要手动将三个随机数生成器设置为最多比图像文件夹中的图像数量少一（计数从零开始）。我可能会在某个时候发布具有随机选择设置的图像目录加载器节点的修改版本来解决此问题。鉴于有些事情需要调整，这可能最好不要成为您第一次尝试 ComfyUI。

此工作流程使用许多自定义节点。使用管理器下载丢失的文件。

该 zip 文件包含工作流程的 A 和 B 版本。版本 A 在雇佣修复中包含 IP 适配器映像，而 B 则不包含。 A 的图像往往感觉更卡通和奇幻，而 B 的图像更锐利，更倾向于超现实主义。

注意：此存档中不包含我的通配符文件或 IP 适配器图像。我想鼓励每个人在这个工作流程中提出自己的想法。 :)

o.en:
Update: The 1.1 version swaps out the older dynamic prompts wildcard node for a replacement that's a full (or at least better) implementation of dynamic prompts' wildcard format. It also adds a final upscale and sharpening step that blows the image up to 4k and sharpens it with Photon v1, giving it razor sharp detail and more saturated color without messing with the image in other ways. If you don't want the second upscale step, just bypass those nodes in ComfyUI.

This workflow is great at making fantastic worlds. It works by randomly selecting three images from a folder that you specify, then combining them all with IP adapter along with your prompt, so that you end up with a result roughly analogous to an artist using an inspiration board. I've personally gathered a large folder of images and I just let it run for a while and see what it comes up with.

One caveat is that there isn't a way that I know of to get an automatic count of images in a folder, so the three random number generators need to be manually set to a maximum of one less than the number of images in your image folder (the count starts at zero). I may release a modified version of the image directory loader node with a random select setting at some point to fix this problem. Given that some things need to be tweaked, it's probably best for this not to be your first foray into ComfyUI.

This workflow uses a number of custom nodes. Use Manager to download the missing ones.

The zip file contains an A and B version of the workflow. Version A includes the IP Adapter images in the hires fix, and B does not. A's images tend to feel a bit more cartoonish and fantastical, while B's are a bit sharper and tend more toward hyperrealism.

Note: Not included in this archive are my wildcard files or IP Adapter images. I'd like to encourage everyone to come up with their own voice with this workflow. :)
